name: Brian S.
headline: Global Vice President of Professional Services at SOVOS | B2B SaaS Software
about:
PROFESSIONAL SERVICES & CUSTOMER SUCCESS EXECUTIVE specializing in implementing programs that impact the bottom line, managing global teams, and transforming businesses through process and strategy. 

For 20 years, I’ve worked with global SaaS companies in professional services and customer success. I have a proven track record in transforming customer engagement programs that improve NPS, retain more clients, deliver cost savings, and impact margin growth. The fact that my last name is Sas is just a coincidence. 

To me, the real value of software professional services is finding ways to positively impact the customer’s business while also delivering results to our bottom line. I’ve partnered with colleagues across the organization to trigger systemwide changes that deliver positive outcomes.

experiences.description:
Private equity backed (Hg & TA Associates)

As the Global VP of Professional Services, I lead a team of several hundred professionals across Europe, Latin America, North America, and Asia, managing the  P&L to drive business and revenue goals. Collaborating closely with the Chief Customer Officer and senior leadership,  focusing on defining strategic plans that prioritize customer centricity, profitability and operational efficiency. I oversee performance metrics, streamline global processes, and develop tools to ensure high accountability and service excellence. Additionally, I manage organizational changes, while fostering a culture of high performance and continuous improvement, delivering exceptional value to clients worldwide.

Private equity backed (Warburg Pincus)
Modernizing Medicine® and its affiliated companies are revolutionizing healthcare by transforming the way information is created, consumed, and utilized, aiming to enhance practice efficiency and improve patient outcomes. Our suite of specialty-specific, data-driven, and cloud-based electronic health records (EHR), practice management (PM) systems, and revenue cycle management (RCM) services was designed by a team of specialty physicians and practice management experts.

I was brought on board to overhaul the professional services organization, aiming to establish consistency, create repeatable processes, scale the organization, enhance customer satisfaction, and drive the professional services strategy. As the VP of Professional Services, I am responsible for leading and ensuring the successful execution and profitable growth of our software delivery business. 

My key responsibilities include:
- Driving implementation strategy and working cross-functionally to execute the entire go-to-market effort with a focus on revenue growth and scalability.
- Fostering an engaging and positive culture dedicated to delivering an exceptional client experience that aligns with business objectives.
- Collaborating with General Managers, Sales, Support, and Development teams to ensure we exceed expectations in delivering valuable solutions.
- Managing P&L, including budgeting, forecasting, capacity planning, and regular KPI reporting and analysis, and Revenue Recognition.
- Developing, monitoring, and executing operational plans.
- Crafting and implementing strategies and plans to help teams adopt new programs and processes.
- Serving as an executive sponsor and providing executive-level escalation for service engagements.
- Acting as a coach and mentor for line staff managers.

experiences.position: SVP North America Customer Engagement √ Business Turnaround √ Customer Retention √ Change Management
experiences.description:
Private equity backed (Leonard Green and Partners, sold to Clarivate in 2020 for $6.8B)
I was hired at CPA Global to rebuild the customer engagement team and implement a customer success program that would help retain our clients. Within two years, we boosted our customer retention to 98% and increased our NPS 20 points. We also achieved 180%+ of its 2020 Q1 budget. 

RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT – Reduced AR over 90 days by 50% in 12 months, which was a direct correlation to bringing our relationships managers into the collection process. 

ISSUE RESOLUTION – Set processes in place to respond to all customer inquiries within 24 hours and find resolution within 48 hours. We have been able to resolve issues within 48 hours 84% of the time, which previously had taken more than 300 weeks for certain issues.

experiences.position: Chief Delivery Officer √Process Improvement √ Cost Reduction √ Program Implementation
experiences.description:
Private equity backed (Warburg Pincus, 2018 successful exit sold to Summit Partners for 5x+ MOIC). +/- 300 employees, approx. $120M in annual revenue
I was promoted to the Chief Delivery Officer shortly after I joined the company. In this role, I put significant process improvements in place to influence our customer’s success. By creating a standardized process, we reduced the implementation costs up to 50% while increasing operating margin 12%. 

NPS IMPROVEMENT – Boosted NPS score 112% within 18 months through targeted marketing campaigns. 

CUSTOMER RETENTION – Established a Client Success Management team, which improved retention 37%. 

CHANGE MANAGEMENT – Garnered buy-in from upper- and lower-level colleagues to make significant changes across delivery and implementation processes. 

ISSUE RESOLUTION – Reduced average outstanding issue time from 650+ days to <45

experiences.description:
When I joined MercuryGate as the Senior Executive VP of Professional Services, I quickly transformed the professional services processes to create a standardized process for client delivery. By setting up a consistent methodology, we tripled throughput in 2018 with a lean staff. 

CUSTOMER UTILIZATION – Improved billable utilization 30 points by setting timelines in place to get clients up and running within a set time period. 

CUSTOMER ENGAGEMENT – Spearheaded CIO roundtables to garner key information about product feedback and industry trends. 

I surpassed the revenue and customer satisfaction goals for my division and was awarded the Founders Club Award for Overachievement

experiences.position: Regional VP, Consulting Services – Americas, Retail & eCommerce √ Global Team Management
experiences.description:
Publicly traded (NYSE/NASDAQ:N), acquired by Oracle July 2016 for $9.3B.
I was the Regional VP of Consulting Services for the Americas after Oracle acquired NetSuite. In this role, I managed an international team in six countries and quickly sought to understand the culture of my employees in order to drive success and build relationships. 

E-COMMERCE – With an understanding of B2C e-commerce, I was tasked to bring that knowledge to the B2B business. This approach included fixing the product within the ERP and educating customers on how best to utilize the application. 

MARGIN GROWTH – Realized an 18-point margin increase through my actions.

experiences.position: Regional VP, Professional Services √ Customer Delivery √ Margin Growth
experiences.description:
Publicly traded (NYSE/NASDAQ: JDA), de-listed and acquired by Red Prairie Holdings for $1.9B.
When I joined JDA, I was brought in to manage the delivery of the professional services for our retail division. After realizing success in retail, I quickly assumed responsibility for the professional services for the manufacturing side of the business. 

During my time, JDA was awarded a Gartner Magic Quadrant ranking. 

OFFSHORE MANAGEMENT – Managed direct reports in Chile, Mexico, Brazil, the US, and Canada with Centers of Excellence in India and Poland. Expanded our offshore billable hours to 37% of total hours, an increase from 2% previously. 

BUSINESS IMPACT – Without growing costs within the organization, we increased EBITDA 11% and grew our margin from 9% to 27%.

experiences.position: VP, North America Consulting Services √Revenue Growth √ Data Insight √ Billable Utilization
experiences.description:
Private Equity Backed (Golden Gate and Summit Partners $3.2B annual revenue, 17,000 employees. 
I was hired at Infor to run its project management team. This role was the training ground that fed the rest of my career – I learned about using data, asking the right questions, and managing people effectively. 

During my time, my team achieved the highest average rate per hour within the company and attained the highest client satisfaction scores worldwide. 

REVENUE & MARGIN GROWTH – Used Infor’s quality back office data to realize cost-effective package solutions that increased revenue >50% and operating margin >40%.

CUSTOMER SATISFACTION – Improved the average utilization >75% and reduced the AR over 90 days by >50% through customer engagement methods.
